title: a block an older jitso put in a CLAUDE.md or .claude/CLAUDE.md that imports AGENTS.md is taken out by the same run that writes AGENTS.md
source: intended: owner decision (v0.2): JITSO writes instruction blocks to AGENTS.md files only, never to CLAUDE.md
intended: owner decision (v0.3): the old block moves out only of a Claude file that imports AGENTS.md, so Claude Code still reads the block
intent: INTENDED behavior (setup instructions writes AGENTS.md only). An older jitso appended the block (`added=1`) to a Claude memory file that imports AGENTS.md (`@AGENTS.md` in `CLAUDE.md`, `@../AGENTS.md` in `.claude/CLAUDE.md`, because Claude Code resolves an import relative to the file that holds it). One `setup instructions --yes` migrates: it creates `AGENTS.md` with the block and removes the old block from the Claude file byte-exactly (after a backup), so that file gets its original bytes back and Claude Code reads the block through the import. A second run is `nothing to do` and names only `AGENTS.md`. A Claude file that does not import AGENTS.md keeps its block: `claude-md-without-the-import-keeps-its-block`.

stdout.equals: jitso setup instructions: nothing to do (the JITSO block is up to date in AGENTS.md)
